title: To extend the SBIR and STTR programs, and for other purposes.
short_title: To extend the SBIR and STTR programs, and for other purposes.
committees: S-Small Business and Entrepreneurship Committee: Referred To 2025-09-16 || H-Science, Space, and Technology Committee: Referred To 2025-09-02 -> Discharged From 2025-09-10 || H-Small Business Committee: Referred To 2025-09-02 -> Markup By 2025-09-09 -> Reported By 2025-09-10
latest_action: Received in the Senate and Read twice and referred to the Committee on Small Business and Entrepreneurship.
summary: This bill reauthorizes through FY2026 the Small Business Innovation Research (SBIR) program, the Small Business Technology Transfer (STTR) program, and related pilot programs. The SBIR and STTR programs are administered by various federal agencies and provide competitive awards for domestic small businesses to conduct research and development projects that have the potential for commercialization.

journey.note: Passed the House; waiting on the Senate
